name: tag-list
title: Tag list
description: A row of tags that never breaks the layout: it shows what fits, then a '+3' button that opens the rest.
docs: Give the list a width to fit into (a table column or max-w class), then fit shows what fits and max caps the count; before it has measured, the server HTML shows only the whole tags that fit one line. The group is named like Design, Research and 3 more. Tags with an href are links; others call onTagSelect.
